name: tripartite motif containing 65

function.text: TRIM65 is the approved symbol for tripartite motif containing 65. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in protein domain specific binding; ubiquitin protein ligase activity; antiviral innate immune response.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Hepatocellular carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: TRIM65 encodes tripartite motif containing 65. Its functions include protein domain specific binding and ubiquitin protein ligase activity.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TRIM65 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and lung squamous cell carcinoma.
